spans.s: --the round arch of a temple where the images of गौरी and विनायक are enshrined. M. २६९. ३५, ५४-6.

(I)--a son of विरजा (the daughter of ऋक्ष) and Mahendra. Crowned king of किष्किन्द and ruled with सुग्रीव; wife तारा and son Angada: crossed the seas, van- quished रावण at पुष्कर, and agreed to be his ally on his request; performed Vedic यज्ञस्, learned in the Vedic lore; applauded by नारद;
1: Br.

. २१४-48.
killed by राम.
2: भा. IX. १०. १२; Vi.
(II)--an Asura in the सभा of हिरण्यकशिपु. M. १६१. ८१.
(III)--an अवतार् of the Lord in the १३थ् dva1para in the वालखिल्याश्रम of the गन्धमादन with तपस्विन् sons. वा. २३. १५९.
